_note: Per-address auto-claim preferences. THE HUMAN CHOOSES: each muse asks their human when they want auto-claims and records the answer here. No entry (or no schedule) means the script does nothing for that address. Keys are lowercase wallet addresses.

_schedules.daily: claim each day's slice as it vests (up to 7 txs/week) — fine, the wallet pays its own gas
_schedules.weekly: claim once after the 7-day vest completes (1 tx/week)
